name: Ardenmoor, the East
description: Lake, cliff, salt and sand. The land is bigger here and the people are fewer, and the dangers are the kind that look like scenery.

ae_0_0.name: The Cliff Path
ae_0_0.description: A path along the foot of a grey cliff. Water is falling somewhere above you, and the rock is dark with spray.

ae_0_1.name: The Waterfall Ledge
ae_0_1.description: A narrow ledge under a long white fall. Behind the water there is a dark seam in the rock that might be a doorway.

ae_0_2.name: The Windy Plateau
ae_0_2.description: A bare shelf of hill where the wind never stops. A cave mouth has been cut into the bank, and someone has hung a lantern at its entrance.

ae_1_0.name: Lake Sorrel, West Shore
ae_1_0.description: The west shore of a wide slate-grey lake. A squat, round building of black stone stands at the edge of the water, with a pinwheel carved over its door.

ae_1_1.name: The Old Dock
ae_1_1.description: A long grey dock of silvered planks, running out into the lake until the lake takes it. The water beyond is too wide and too cold to wade.

east.failure_message: The water past the dock is too wide and too cold to wade. A raft would carry you.

ae_2_0.name: Dry Reeds
ae_2_0.description: Reeds gone to straw, rattling together, over ground that has stopped being wet. A narrow cave has been dug into the bank.

ae_2_1.name: The Salt Flats
ae_2_1.description: A white crust of salt over cracked mud, shining under the sky. Things move under it.

ae_2_2.name: The Dune Edge
ae_2_2.description: Where the salt gives way to sand, in long yellow ridges that run on south as far as you can see.

ae_3_0.name: The Cracked Flats
ae_3_0.description: Baked earth in plates the size of tables, curled at the edges. The air shimmers over it.

ae_3_1.name: The Dune Sea
ae_3_1.description: A sea of dunes under a white sun. Your footprints fill in behind you before you have turned to look.

ae_3_2.name: The Crescent Stones
ae_3_2.description: A ring of leaning stones in the sand, open on one side, like a moon that has lost its other half. A stair goes down into the ground between the horns.

waterfall_cave.name: A Cave Behind the Fall
waterfall_cave.description: A cave behind the water, green with moss, with a black pool in the middle and the roar of the fall filling it.

shop_cave.name: A Lantern-Lit Cave
shop_cave.description: A shallow cave with a lantern hung at its mouth and a barrel for a counter.

hint_cave.name: A Dry Hollow
hint_cave.description: A dry hollow in the bank, hardly more than a hole.

ae_island.name: A Small Island
ae_island.description: A hump of rock and grass in the middle of the lake, with a single crooked tree. Something red glows in the roots of it.
